options in simple terms:

Wax melts: These are small scented wax pieces you place in the warmer. They’re a flame-free way to fragrance your home.


Starter kit / kit builder: This is a great beginner option where you choose a warmer and pick 3 scents to get started.

turns.q: How do I use it properly the very first time?
turns.replyTail:
appy Wax • AI Assistant
For your first use:



Read the warmer instructions and safety info.


If it uses a light bulb, make sure to remove any plastic around the bulb first.


Wipe the top of the warmer clean.


If your warmer has a silicone dish, just use that—no extra liner needed.


Add about 1 oz / 1 cube, or 2–3 bears.


Do not add water or oil.


Plug it in, turn it on, and set a timer if your warmer doesn’t have one.



If you have any other questions or need more tips, feel free to ask!
